meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 9 个维度扫描代码(用 grep、AST-grep 等工具),把每个问题标到具体文件和行号,评估严重程度与修复工时,并生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,给出优先级排序和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当你提到“技术债”、“代码健康检查”、“架构审查”等说法,或要求做代码质量评估、清理规划时触发。

say.text: 给这个仓库跑一次技术债审计。
检查代码健康度,重点看架构和测试。
say.note: 报告会标出严重程度、工时和快速修复项。

say.text: 按 tech-debt-audit 协议审计代码质量,列出 Top 5 优先项。
say.note: 输出含 file:line 引用的问题清单。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude audits code across 9 dimensions using grep and AST-grep. Findings are cited by file:line:col, scored for severity and effort, then compiled into TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with ranked priorities and quick fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a technical debt audit, code health check, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning—e.g., mentioning “tech debt” or “code health”.

say_en.text: Run a technical debt audit on this repo.
Check code health, focusing on architecture and tests.
say_en.note: Report includes severity, effort, and quick wins.

say_en.text: Audit code quality per the tech-debt-audit protocol, list Top 5 priorities.
